name: io.github.WYRE-AI/alga-psa-mcp
title: Alga PSA
description: Curated MCP server with 71 Alga PSA tools and request-scoped gateway credentials.

environmentVariables.name: ALGA_INSTANCE_URL
environmentVariables.description: The https:// address you use to sign in to Alga, with nothing after the domain (for example https://psa.example.com). Works for Nine Minds–hosted and self-hosted instances. Self-hosted instances must be reachable from the internet over HTTPS with a valid certificate.

environmentVariables.name: ALGA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for the Alga user this connection acts as. Create it in Alga under Profile → API Keys. The key gets that user's permissions, so use a dedicated user with a limited role.

environmentVariables.name: ALGA_TENANT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Leave blank. Only set it if Alga support asks you to; a wrong value makes every request fail with 401
